description: Chicory is a tall perennial grown for its clear sky-blue daisy-like flowers, which open along wiry stems through summer and close by early afternoon. why: The whole description was written about a different plant from the row. Belgian endive is not a separate species but a forced cultivar group of this one, so the text described a vegetable crop and then disowned the species it belongs to. Rewritten around the ornamental habit a reader of this catalog sees, with the endive connection stated correctly rather than as a separate plant. Audited 2026-08-18.
